question: How do I configure my Java SDK to publish to the new Maven Central Portal instead of the legacy Nexus Repository?
ground_truth: To publish to the new Maven Central Portal, set the output location to "maven" and add "publish-to: central" in your generators.yml configuration. To use the legacy Nexus Repository instead, use "publish-to: ossrh".

metadata.cited_context: In the `group` for your Java SDK, change the output location in `generators.yml` from `local-file-system` (the default) to `maven` to indicate that Fern should publish your package directly to the Maven Central registry. Then, add `publish-to: central` to indicate that the publish target is the new Maven Central Portal (Sonatype). To publish to the legacy Nexus Repository, use `publish-to: ossrh`.
